# sh-fpv-sheet-phone-number

**Purpose:** The only place her number and email show.

**Built from:** sh-bottom-sheet + sh-icon-button-with-label (Shaadi Chat, WhatsApp, Call) + sh-button.

**Switches:** State.

**Rules:** one contact view is used on the first open per profile; Shaadi Chat, WhatsApp, Call, SMS and Email never charge.
